items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: I'll never forget the first time I ever saw Nina Mae McKinney.

ctx.x: So the show itself. What was the show like? You know, from begining to end.

Oh, we'd play opening number and then the chorus girls would come out and then they would have maybe a dance team or they may have a woman singing first and then they'd have a dance team and then the singing star, you know what I mean. I'll never forget the first time I ever saw Nina Mae McKinney. Of course, you know, she had a tremendous reputation and I had a chance to...that's big time you know...and I was really impressed, she had so much class, you know. And I found out later that she made a lot of movies…
She sang there at the Club Congo as part of the same show?
